Messages.Author: Matt Flint
Messages.Body:
I have a question about whether actions such as that allowed by the
Rack actually target the Rack. Here is a situation in which this
question can be posed:

Situation: I control a vampire. Someone else controls the Rack.
Someone else also has a vampire with a Haven Uncovered on them.

Question: Does the action to take the Rack target the Rack? The Rack
gives my vampire a possible action based on a card in play, but it
does not say that I must target the Rack to do so. I do not have to
select or choose the Rack except to state what allows the action.
Example: "(tapping my vampire) My vampire chooses to take the action
allowed by the Rack". This would seem to be similar to taking the
action allowed by a Haven Uncovered. One would not say that the action
allowed by Haven Uncovered targets the Haven Uncovered, right? (In
fact, it targets the minion the haven is on, right?) What is the
difference between these two cases?

Compare with:
Situation: I control a vampire with superior Necromancy. Someone else
controls the Rack.

In this case, if I wanted to burn the Rack with a Haunt, I know that
it targets the Rack, since card text on Haunt requires that I choose
or select a location.

-----
Here is some possibly relevant text:

Rulebook (1.6.1-5)

Targets. If a card is played on another card, or selects or chooses or
otherwise targets another card, the target card must be in play (i.e.,
controlled). Vampires in the torpor region are eligible targets by
default, but vampires in the uncontrolled region and contested cards
are not.

------

The Rack [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U]
Cardtype: Master
Master: unique location.
When this card is brought into play or the controller of this card
changes, the controller chooses a ready vampire he or she controls.
During the controller's untap phase, the chosen vampire gains 2 blood
from the blood bank. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can
steal this location for his or her controller as a (D) action.

------

Haunt [FN:C2/PG]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Necromancy
+1 stealth <action>.
[nec] Put this card on a location you control. The controller of this
location can burn this card to cause an action directed at this
location to fail. A location can have only one Haunt.
[NEC] (D) Burn a location that doesn't require Giovanni to play.

Thanks
Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Matt Flint wrote:
> I have a question about whether actions such as that allowed by the
> Rack actually target the Rack. Here is a situation in which this
> question can be posed:

Yes.

> Situation: I control a vampire. Someone else controls the Rack.
> Someone else also has a vampire with a Haven Uncovered on them.
>
> Question: Does the action to take the Rack target the Rack? The Rack

Yes.

> gives my vampire a possible action based on a card in play, but it
> does not say that I must target the Rack to do so. I do not have to

The action that steals the Rack can only be used to steal the Rack.
You cannot use that action to target something other than the Rack.

> select or choose the Rack except to state what allows the action.

?

> Example: "(tapping my vampire) My vampire chooses to take the action
> allowed by the Rack". This would seem to be similar to taking the

"May vampire attempts to steal the Rack" (since the Rack offers no
other action).

> action allowed by a Haven Uncovered. One would not say that the action
> allowed by Haven Uncovered targets the Haven Uncovered, right? (In
> fact, it targets the minion the haven is on, right?) What is the
> difference between these two cases?

"My vampire attempts to enter combat with the vampire" is the action
allowed by the Haven Uncovered.

> Compare with:
> Situation: I control a vampire with superior Necromancy. Someone else
> controls the Rack.
>
> In this case, if I wanted to burn the Rack with a Haunt, I know that
> it targets the Rack, since card text on Haunt requires that I choose
> or select a location.

And the action allowed by the Rack itself requires that you target the
Rack - it doesn't allow for any other target.

> -----
> Here is some possibly relevant text:
>

> The Rack [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U]

> steal *this location* for his or her controller as a (D) action.

Emphasis added.
